description: Build a phenology histogram for a taxon in an area — which months, weeks, or years it is recorded in. The default month_of_year interval answers "when does this bloom or appear here" in twelve buckets; the absolute intervals (year, month, week, day, hour) bucket real dates and upstream applies a default start date to them. An area is given in exactly one form: place_id, the lat/lng/radius triple in kilometres, or a four-corner bounding box. Omit taxon_id to chart every taxon in the area. Narrow to one life stage or reproductive state with an annotation pair (term_id and term_value_id, e.g. Life Stage = Larva, or Flowers and Fruits = Flowers), or to broad groups with iconic_taxa. Defaults to research-grade, wild-only records and echoes those defaults back.

captive.description: Whether to include captive and cultivated records — zoo animals, garden plantings. Defaults to wild organisms only.

d1.description: Earliest observation date, YYYY-MM-DD. Inclusive. Must be on or before d2. With interval set to day or hour, a wide range can exceed the 800-bucket cap — narrow d1/d2 to reach buckets past it.

date_field.description: Which date to bucket by: when the organism was observed, or when the record was uploaded.

iconic_taxa.description: Broad organism groups, by their scientific iconic-taxon name. A common-name value such as "Birds" matches nothing upstream, so only the listed values are accepted.

interval.description: Bucketing. month_of_year and week_of_year fold every year together into a seasonal curve; the rest bucket absolute dates. day and hour over a wide date range can generate thousands of buckets — the response is capped at 800, kept from the start of the range; narrow d1/d2 or use a coarser interval to see the rest.

lat.description: Latitude of the search centre, in decimal degrees. Requires lng and radius.

lng.description: Longitude of the search centre, in decimal degrees. Requires lat and radius.

nelat.description: North-east corner latitude of the bounding box, at or north of swlat. All four corners or none.

nelng.description: North-east corner longitude of the bounding box. All four corners or none. West of swlng is accepted: it describes a box crossing the antimeridian.

place_id.description: Numeric iNaturalist place id from inaturalist_find_places. Mutually exclusive with the lat/lng/radius triple and the bounding box. A non-numeric value answers HTTP 500 upstream.

quality_grade.description: Identification confidence tiers to include. Defaults to research-grade only; adding "needs_id" roughly doubles the corpus and lowers identification confidence.

radius.description: Search radius around lat/lng, in KILOMETRES, greater than 0. Requires lat and lng. The upstream publishes no bound; 500 is a verified ceiling this server imposes.

swlat.description: South-west corner latitude of the bounding box. All four corners or none.

swlng.description: South-west corner longitude of the bounding box. All four corners or none.

taxon_id.description: Restrict to this taxon and its descendants. Omit to chart every taxon in the area. Resolve a name to an id with inaturalist_resolve_name.

term_id.description: Annotation attribute ids, from inaturalist_list_reference topic controlled_terms — e.g. 1 for Life Stage.

term_value_id.description: Annotation value ids, from the same attribute listing — e.g. 6 for Larva. Requires term_id; sent alone it is ignored upstream and the unfiltered corpus comes back.

name: inaturalist_get_histogram

applied_filters.description: The server-applied defaults that determine what this answer means.

captive.description: Whether captive and cultivated records were included.

date_field.description: Which date the buckets were built from.

buckets.description: Every bucket upstream returned, in order, including the zero ones — up to 800, the first in upstream key order. See the truncated/shown/cap enrichment when more exist.

key.description: Bucket label, in upstream order — "1"…"12" for month_of_year, a date for the absolute intervals.

cap.description: The bucket cap that was applied.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_geography`: An area was given partially, in two forms at once, with a radius of 0 or less, or with nelat south of swlat. `inverted_date_range`: d1 is after d2. `unpaired_annotation_value`: term_value_id was supplied without term_id. `unknown_taxon_id`: iNaturalist answered 422 because the taxon_id does not exist. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

notice.description: Guidance when every bucket came back zero, or when the cap was reached.

shown.description: How many buckets this response carries.

total.description: Sum of every bucket count upstream returned, including buckets past the cap that are not in the buckets array.

truncated.description: True when upstream returned more than 800 buckets.

title: Inaturalist Get Histogram
